593:t_000:1.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「What is $$ネオ・ジオン$$ doing?」

593:t_000:2.en:
$$フラスト$$
「They're still watching us from a distance.」

593:t_000:3.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「What do you think, Staff Officer $$ナナイ$$?」

593:t_000:4.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「I believe $$フル・フロンタル$$ will wait for an opening to intervene in our battle with $$クロノ$$.」

593:t_000:5.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「They can't locate the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ themselves, so they can only attack us by following $$クロノ$$'s movements.」

593:t_000:6.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「They want $$ラプラスの箱$$ badly enough to abduct me for it.」

593:t_000:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$ハマーン$$, you, and I... The three women who stood beside $$シャア$$... All of us now face that man.」

593:t_000:11.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「We each have our own position, but $$ハマーン$$ and I both think this is only natural.」

593:t_001:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「...The resonance between $$スフィア・リアクター$$s is a real nuisance at times like this.」

593:t_001:1.en:
$$メール$$
「But it's unfair. The Empire's Reactors can sense us, while sometimes we can't sense them.」

593:t_001:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$'s $$スフィア$$ research is far more advanced. They've developed countermeasures, too.」

593:t_001:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So our presence ruins the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$'s stealth.」

593:t_001:4.en:
$$カトル$$
「There's no need to worry. We have to settle things with both $$クロノ$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ anyway.」

593:t_001:5.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「If they're coming to us, that saves us the trouble of going to them.」

593:t_001:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you ready, $$バナージ$$?」

593:t_001:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Don't tense up. Impatience and tension slow the workings of your heart.」

593:t_001:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You seem calm, $$マリーダ$$.」

593:t_001:10.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...Not really. I'm always tense on the battlefield.」

593:t_001:11.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I especially dislike the waiting just before an operation begins.」

593:t_001:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...$$マリーダ$$... What do you like?」

593:t_001:13.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Why ask that out of the blue?」

593:t_001:14.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Because I'd rather know what you like than what you dislike.」

593:t_001:15.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...I've never thought about it much.」

593:t_001:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then what's your favorite food? There must be something you find delicious, right? Like sweets.」

593:t_001:17.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...I think... I like ice cream.」

593:t_001:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I know a place. A great shop in $$インダストリアル７$$.」

593:t_001:19.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's go when this battle's over.」

593:t_001:20.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You've got guts, asking someone on a date right before a battle.」

593:t_001:22.en:
$$クェス$$
「Wouldn't you be in trouble if $$ミネバ$$ heard that invitation?」

593:t_001:23.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Of course $$オードリー$$'s coming, too.」

593:t_001:26.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$. Tell me what two-timing means.」

593:t_001:27.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Wait a second! That's not what I meant...」

593:t_001:30.en:
$$宗介$$
「Your tension was so painful to watch that even $$レド$$ wanted to make a joke.」

593:t_001:31.en:
$$アル$$
「That was an excellent assist, Ensign $$レド$$.」

593:t_001:33.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't you feel a little more relaxed now?」

593:t_001:35.en:
$$甲児$$
「It isn't just $$ガンダム$$ pilots who have your back.」

593:t_001:36.en:
$$葵$$
「$c will support you with everything we've got.」

593:t_001:37.en:
$$タケル$$
「So please make sure you stop Ensign $$リディ$$. He was our comrade, too.」

593:t_001:40.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Just so you know, $$マリーダ$$, you're one of them, too.」

593:t_001:41.en:
$$ファ$$
「So don't push yourself too hard. I know keeping up with $$バナージ$$'s recklessness must be tough.」

593:t_001:44.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Thank you, $$バナージ$$. You were trying to ease my tension, too.」

593:t_001:45.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You might say I should worry about myself first...」

593:t_001:46.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But thanks to everyone, I've calmed down, too.」

593:t_001:48.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Yes... To give it our all.」

593:t_001:50.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, prepare to intercept!」
